title: Add CHANGELOG.md
description: Create CHANGELOG.md following the Keep a Changelog format. Document all v0.1.0 features in an [Unreleased] section.
acceptanceCriteria: Lists rocket new, rocket loop (copilot backend), rocket init, rocket tasks as added features

steps.details: Create CHANGELOG.md with header: # Changelog. All notable changes to rocket-cli are documented here. Format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com).

Add: ## [Unreleased]. ### Added. List all features: - `rocket new` command for scaffolding projects (webapp and website templates), - `rocket loop` command for AI-powered development loop (Copilot CLI, Claude, Docker backends), - `rocket init` for initializing .agent/ structure in existing projects, - `rocket tasks` TUI for viewing and managing tasks, - `rocket feature` for AI-powered feature spec generation, - `rocket status` for project progress dashboard.
